card.title: IPad Pro 11in 1st Gen Not Recognized by PC in Recovery Mode or Charging Issues

source.title: IPad Pro 11in 1st Gen Not Recognized by PC in Recovery Mode or Charging Issues

symptoms: not detected by PC in recovery/DFU
charges only on 15 V or only on 5 V

claims.statement: iPad Pro 11 (2018) charging/PC detection faults usually come from the charge port (not soldered, easy to swap), the CD3215 (handles USB-C PD 15 V) or the Tristar 610A3C (handles 5 V).
Charges on 5 V USB-A but won't negotiate 15 V = CD3215; charges at 15 V PD but not 5 V = Tristar 610A3C.
The 610A3C Tristar is unique to this model and iPad Pro 12.9 3rd gen and is not interchangeable with other Tristars; it sits under the shield above the screen FPCs.

procedure: Diode-check caps around CD3215; inject 1 V / 1 A to find cap vs IC.
Replace the faulty IC; verify 15 V and 5 V charging and PC detection.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
